regions.summary: DrawCompositeSprites: Read three-byte records until $FF. First byte high nibble is vertical offset subtracted from Y; second byte high five bits are horizontal offset added to X. This exact selection rule is retained without guessing why a particular object uses sequential versus explicit tile numbers.
